correctness.rationale: The integer shuffle binomial identity verifies the Zinbiel structure over any field. e1-left multiplication is a single nilpotent Jordan shift, so the ideals are exactly suffixes. For the stated n interval, every product in I_{n-pP+1} has a forced carry in the P digit and vanishes modulo p. The larger suffix contains e_{n-pP} and e_{pP}, whose nonzero product is e_n. Hence the exact dimension and uniqueness hold for all parameters. Direct finite enumeration and structure-identity checks passed in 40 parameter triples (n<=96); the proof is independent of experiments.

value.rationale: The invariant beta is the same motivated maximal abelian-ideal dimension studied by Ceballos and Towers. The result gives sharp unbounded characteristic-p intervals, a unique maximal ideal, and exact digit-carry mechanism, with p=2 realizing 2/3 rather than 1/2 of algebra dimension along an infinite sequence. This is a structural modular boundary, not an arbitrary small test or routine specialization.
